criteria.observation: Pass. All three variants preserve the same qualified recommendation: extend the same bounded pilot to the next small cohort. Each explicitly distinguishes that limited evidence-building step from unsupported company-wide rollout or policy adoption, while retaining controls, reassessment, and stopping conditions.
